item.title: How to implement dark mode in React
item.description: Implementing dark mode in React applications improves user experience by reducing eye strain and providing visual preferences that adapt to user environments. As the creator of CoreUI with over 25 years of development experience, I’ve built theme switching systems across numerous production applications. The most effective approach is using React Context with CSS custom properties and localStorage persistence for consistent theme management. This provides seamless theme switching with proper state management and user preference persistence across browser sessions.
